evidence.snippet: alpha(2)delta, auxiliary subunits of voltage-gated calcium channels through which the gabapentinoids gabapentin and pregabalin exert their anticonvulsant and analgesic actions
evidence.explanation: Gabapentin exerts its anticonvulsant action by binding to and modulating the alpha-2-delta auxiliary subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels.

paper.title: New molecular targets for antiepileptic drugs: alpha(2)delta, SV2A, and K(v)7/KCNQ/M potassium channels.

evidence.snippet: binding to the alpha-2-delta protein subunit of voltage-gated calcium channels in the central nervous system, thereby blocking the excitatory influx of calcium

paper.title: Molecular Mechanisms and Therapeutic Potential of Gabapentin with a Focus on Topical Formulations to Treat Ocular Surface Diseases.

evidence.snippet: Gabapentin and pregabalin may bind to the Ca(2+) channel alpha 2 delta subunit to selectively attenuate depolarization-induced Ca(2+) influx of presynaptic P/Q-type Ca(2+) channels
evidence.explanation: The alpha-2-delta subunit modulated by gabapentin decreases activity of the P/Q-type voltage-gated calcium channel, reducing Ca2+ influx.

paper.title: Inhibition of neuronal Ca(2+) influx by gabapentin and pregabalin in the human neocortex.

evidence.snippet: this results in decreased glutamate/aspartate release from excitatory amino acid nerve terminals
evidence.explanation: Reduced P/Q-type Ca2+ channel activity leads to decreased presynaptic calcium influx, which negatively regulates neurotransmitter secretion.

paper.title: Inhibition of neuronal Ca(2+) influx by gabapentin and pregabalin in the human neocortex.

evidence.snippet: They inhibit calcium mediated neurotransmitter release through effects on α2δ-1 subunits

paper.title: Analgesic mechanisms of gabapentinoids and effects in experimental pain models: a narrative review.

evidence.snippet: Functionally, all of the new targets modulate neurotransmitter output at synapses, focusing attention on presynaptic terminals as critical sites of action for AEDs.
evidence.explanation: Excessive neurotransmitter secretion at synapses contributes to neuronal hyperexcitability and seizure generation in epilepsy; modulation of presynaptic neurotransmitter output is the key mechanism through which AEDs including gabapentin treat epilepsy.

paper.title: New molecular targets for antiepileptic drugs: alpha(2)delta, SV2A, and K(v)7/KCNQ/M potassium channels.
